title: Track 1 - CAV: Forged BSM position (CACC platoon)
summary: A leader's SAE J2735 BSMs are forged (+12 m position step). The follower's cooperative controller trusts them and closes on the REAL leader.

nodes.title: Observe
nodes.narration: Real NGSIM Peachtree traffic, 10 Hz BSMs. At t=5.0 s the leader's claimed position jumps 12 m ahead of its true position. The physics verifier (v = v0 + a dt, displacement = v dt, V2X gap vs ranging gap) alerts 200 ms later.

defender.text: Baseline: claimed BSM kinematics are self-consistent.
Claimed position steps +12 m (ground truth unchanged).
Verifier alert: V2X gap disagrees with onboard ranging.

gate.question: The verifier has flagged the leader's BSMs. What does the follower do?

options.label: Keep following the BSM (treat as noise)
options.feedback: The follower keeps trusting a forged position and brakes too late.

options.label: Fall back to onboard ranging immediately
options.feedback: Correct: ranging does not depend on the forged message.

options.label: Wait 5 s for confirmation, then fall back
options.feedback: Waiting for more evidence costs seconds the gap does not have.

nodes.title: Outcome: alert ignored
nodes.narration: The follower believes the leader is 12 m farther away than it is.

defender.text: Alert dismissed. CACC continues on forged data.

nodes.title: Outcome: immediate fallback
nodes.narration: The follower switches to ranging and re-establishes a safe gap.

defender.text: Quarantine the leader's BSMs; switch to radar-only gap control.

nodes.title: Outcome: delayed fallback
nodes.narration: The follower keeps trusting the forged BSMs for five more seconds.
